**Already-built dependencies you'll consume:**

- `app/actions/onboarding.ts` — 5 server actions: `saveStudioStep`, `saveLocationStep`, `saveServiceStep`, `completeOnboarding`, `getOnboardingState`
- `lib/onboarding/schemas.ts` — Zod schemas + `ActionResult<T>` + input types

- `lib/onboarding/service-templates.ts` — `SERVICE_TEMPLATES` array + `getTemplateById`
- `lib/onboarding/constants.ts` — `BOOKING_DOMAIN`

**Already-installed packages:**
- `qrcode` + `@types/qrcode`

---

## What to build

### Delete
- `components/onboarding/StepFirstArtist.tsx` — artist fields folded into Step 1

### Create (6 new files)

**1. `components/onboarding/StepIndicator.tsx`**
- Props: `{ current: number, total: number, labels: string[] }`
- Render per Vega spec (§1 of `onboarding-v2.md`):
  - 4 circles + 3 connectors horizontal
  - Active: `bg-rust text-bone` + soft Rust ring
  - Completed: `bg-onyx text-bone` + CheckCircle2 icon
  - Future: `bg-bone border border-border text-stone`
  - Connector: `bg-onyx` (done segments) vs `bg-border` (upcoming)
  - Mobile (<sm): collapse to dot style, show "Step X of N" text to the right
- Transition: `transition-all duration-200 ease-out` on color changes
- `aria-current="step"` on active, proper label visibility

**2. `components/onboarding/SlugPreview.tsx`**
- Props: `{ name: string }`
- Debounce slug generation at 200ms using a `useMemo` + simple `useEffect` pattern (no external debounce lib)
- Render `book.inkos.app/<slug>` in JetBrains Mono 12px: prefix Stone, slug Onyx
- Empty state: italic Instrument Serif Stone "your-studio-name" placeholder
- Uses `slugify()` from `lib/utils.ts`

**3. `components/onboarding/TimezoneCombobox.tsx`**
- Props: `{ value: string, onChange: (tz: string) => void, id?: string }`
- Use shadcn `<Command>` from `components/ui/command.tsx` inside a `<Popover>`
- Load timezone list from `getAllTimezones()` (grouped by continent)
- Auto-detect + pre-select on mount via `detectBrowserTimezone()` if value is empty
- Trigger styled to match `<Input>` height/border exactly
- Popover: Bone bg, Stone border, `shadow-lift`
- Keyboard: type search, Enter select, Esc close, arrow nav
- Display selected value via `formatTimezoneLabel()`

**4. `components/onboarding/ServiceTemplatePicker.tsx`**
- Props: `{ value: string | null, onChange: (templateId: string, template: ServiceTemplate) => void }`
- Grid: `grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3` gap-3
- Render 6 cards from `SERVICE_TEMPLATES`
- Idle: `bg-bone border border-border rounded-lg p-4 hover:border-onyx/40`
- Selected: `border-onyx shadow-[var(--shadow-card-hover)]`
- Rust dot on the `recommended: true` card (the Standard session) with label "Most studios pick this" — this is the ONE Rust per viewport allowed on this step
- Keyboard: roving tabIndex pattern, arrow keys move focus, Enter selects
- Card content: name Inter 15/700 Onyx, duration + price JetBrains Mono 13 tabular, deposit caption Inter 12 Stone. Free templates show "Free" not "$0".

**5. `components/onboarding/BookingLinkCard.tsx`**
- Props: `{ slug: string, studioName: string }`
- Bone card `border border-onyx rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-[var(--shadow-card)]`
- Booking URL: `book.inkos.app/<slug>` in JetBrains Mono 16px/500 Onyx (use `BOOKING_DOMAIN` constant)
- QR code: render via `qrcode` package as inline SVG (Vega spec §4 justifies SVG over canvas for crisp scaling). Use `qrcode.toString(text, { type: 'svg', color: { dark: '#0F0F0F', light: '#F7F7F5' }, margin: 0, width: 96 })` inside a `useEffect`. Render via `dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: svg }}`. Size 96×96.
- Three buttons in a row (mobile: `flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2`):
  - `Copy link` — primary Onyx button, calls `navigator.clipboard.writeText(\`https://\${BOOKING_DOMAIN}/\${slug}\`)` + `toast.success`
  - `Open preview` — outline button, `asChild` + `<a href={...} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">`
  - `Copy for Instagram bio` — outline button, copies: \`📍 Book now\\n\${BOOKING_DOMAIN}/\${slug}\` + `toast.success`
- Post-onboarding checklist below: separate Bone sub-card `border border-border rounded-lg p-4 mt-4` with 4 items (links to `/settings/branding`, `/settings/team`, `/settings/hours`, `/settings/payments`) — each item `flex items-center gap-2 py-2 border-b border-border last:border-0`, Stone text, Onyx hover

### Edit (5 existing files)

**6. `app/globals.css`** — delete lines 1656–1667 (the purple + green `.onboarding-step-*` CSS). Leave no dead CSS.

**7. `app/(auth)/layout.tsx`** — line 68: replace `style={{ color: '#B23A2B' }}` with `className="font-serif-italic text-rust"`. Verify `text-rust` token exists in `@theme inline` — if not, add a semantic utility or use `text-[var(--color-rust)]`.

**8. `app/(auth)/onboarding/page.tsx`** — rewrite using `getOnboardingState()`:
```
- Server component, async
- Check auth (redirect to /login if not)
- Call getOnboardingState()
- If snapshot.studio?.onboarded_at is set → redirect('/dashboard')
- Pass { studioId, userId, resumeAt, initialFullName, initialStudio } to <OnboardingWizard />
```

**9. `components/onboarding/OnboardingWizard.tsx`** — full rewrite:
- Accept props: `{ studioId, userId, resumeAt, initialFullName, initialStudio }`
- TOTAL_STEPS = 4
- STEP_LABELS = ['Studio', 'Location', 'Service', 'Live']
- Delete the 3px top Rust bar (line 110 in current file)
- Use new `<StepIndicator />` component
- `key={currentStep}` on the step container wrapper for cross-fade
- Container class: `animate-in fade-in-0 slide-in-from-bottom-1 duration-200 ease-out`
- Step map: 1 → Step1, 2 → Step2, 3 → Step3, 4 → Step4
- Step1 renamed: `StepStudioProfile` (keep file path, new internal logic)
- Step2: `StepFirstLocation`
- Step3: `StepFirstService`
- Step4: `StepBookingPageLive`
- Initial step from `resumeAt` not localStorage. Keep localStorage as UX fallback only (if local is > resumeAt, use local; otherwise trust server).

**10. `components/onboarding/StepStudioProfile.tsx`** — merged studio+artist step:
- Fields: `studioName` (autofocus), `timezone` (via TimezoneCombobox), `fullName`, `specialties` (chip picker — reuse the 10 options from old StepFirstArtist)
- Remove logo upload entirely (deferred per plan)
- Add `<SlugPreview name={watchedName} />` under studio name input
- `useForm` with `studioStepSchema` from `lib/onboarding/schemas.ts` resolver
- On submit: call `saveStudioStep(studioId, formData)`. On `ok: false`, show `toast.error(error)`. On success, `onNext()`.
- Editorial copy per plan: title *"Your studio."* (Instrument Serif, use existing `<Typography variant="h1">`), subtitle "Two minutes to a live booking page."
- Button: `Continue` (no arrow glyph)
- autoFocus on studioName input via `useRef` + `useEffect`

**11. `components/onboarding/StepFirstLocation.tsx`** — simplified:
- Required fields: `locationName`, `city`, `country` (text input for now; country combobox is a later polish)
- `<details>` disclosure "Full address (optional)" wrapping: `address`, `state`, `zip`, `phone`
- Mobile: `grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2` on paired rows
- On submit: call `saveLocationStep(studioId, formData)`
- Skip button: call action with `{ locationName: 'Main Studio', city: null, country: 'United States' }` fallback — actually no, `city` is required in schema; use `city: detected-from-tz`. Simpler: require only `locationName` + `country` for skip path; city must be filled by user. Keep skip behavior minimal: inserts row with just locationName + country.
- Title: *"One location, to start."*
- Subtitle: "You can add more later. The essentials are enough."

**12. `components/onboarding/StepFirstService.tsx`** — rewritten with templates:
- Fields: `serviceName`, `durationMin`, `basePrice`, `depositPct`, `description`
- New: `selectedTemplateId` state
- `<ServiceTemplatePicker value={selectedTemplateId} onChange={(id, tpl) => {...}} />` at top
- When template selected: prefill form fields via `reset()` from react-hook-form
- Below template picker: same form fields as today but `grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2` on duration+price
- On submit: call `saveServiceStep(studioId, formData)`
- Skip: call action with the `custom` template defaults
- Title: *"Your first service."*
- Subtitle: "Pick a template or write your own. You'll edit it later."

**13. `components/onboarding/StepBookingPageLive.tsx`** — rewritten as first-win:
- Use `<BookingLinkCard slug={slug} studioName={name} />`
- On mount: `completeOnboarding(studioId)` once. Track an `useRef` flag to prevent double-fire from Strict Mode.
- Remove the giant CheckCircle2 at top — the URL is the celebration
- Title: *"Live."* (serif, big, solo)
- Subtitle: "Your booking page is public. Share the link."
- Primary CTA at bottom: `Open the studio` → `router.push('/dashboard')`
- PostHog event fires server-side now (inside `completeOnboarding`). Remove all client-side `window.posthog` references from this file.
- Remove `@ts-expect-error`

### Verification

```bash
cd "/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS"
pnpm typecheck     # exit 0
pnpm build         # clean build, no warnings
```

### Forbidden
- `any`
- `console.log`
- Default Tailwind shadows (use `shadow-soft/card/soft-md/lift/overlay`)
- Raw hex in JSX
- Direct `supabase.from(...)` writes from components (all writes go through actions)
- `@ts-expect-error`
- Colors outside Bone/Onyx/Stone/Rust
- Inline `style` with color
- Any new `onboarding-step-*` CSS class — use Tailwind utilities directly

### Report

List every file created/modified/deleted, `pnpm typecheck` output, `pnpm build` output (top-level), any edge case you hit. Under 400 words.

1	# InkOS Onboarding — Full Rebuild Plan
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	Onboarding currently ships working UI but has **critical data-loss bugs**, **brand violations**, and a **forced-feeling 5-step gauntlet** that drops users at the first DMV-style form. Screenshot shows purple step-1 circle (brand locks palette to Bone/Onyx/Stone/Rust only).
6	
7	**Pain the user named:**
8	- Flow feels boring, forced, not branded
9	- Bugs exist — Yash wants zero
10	- Database integration incomplete
11	- Needs top-tier SaaS pattern polish
12	- Must carry the InkOS editorial voice
13	
14	**Outcome:** 4-step, autosave-backed, editorial-toned onboarding. Every write hits the database through typed server actions. Every color is brand-safe. Every field the user types persists. Mobile, keyboard, a11y, tests — all complete. User ends holding a live booking URL, a QR code, and a copy-paste Instagram bio link — the true first win.
15	
16	---
17	
18	## What's Broken Today (audit results)
19	
20	### Critical data-loss bugs
21	
22	| # | File | Bug |
23	|---|------|-----|
24	| 1 | [StepFirstService.tsx:72](components/onboarding/StepFirstService.tsx#L72) | Services **never inserted** — localStorage only. The form is decorative. |
25	| 2 | [StepFirstArtist.tsx:102-107](components/onboarding/StepFirstArtist.tsx#L102-L107) | Specialties **never inserted** — localStorage only. No `artists` row created. |
26	| 3 | [StepFirstLocation.tsx:60-68](components/onboarding/StepFirstLocation.tsx#L60-L68) | `phone` collected but omitted from insert. Column exists on `locations`. |
27	| 4 | [StepFirstArtist.tsx:84-99](components/onboarding/StepFirstArtist.tsx#L84-L99) | Step 3 updates `profiles.full_name` + upserts `studio_members` but **never creates the `artists` row**, so the owner isn't bookable. |
28	| 5 | All steps | All writes are client-side direct Supabase calls. No server-side validation, no audit log entry, no RPC-wrapped atomicity. |
29	| 6 | [StepStudioProfile.tsx:22-35](components/onboarding/StepStudioProfile.tsx#L22-L35) | Only 12 hardcoded timezones. UK/EU/India/Dubai/Brazil studios stuck. No auto-detect. |
30	| 7 | Service schema mismatch | Form collects `depositPct` (percent). DB stores `deposit_cents` (absolute integer). Drift guaranteed once persisted. |
31	
32	### Brand violations
33	
34	| # | File | Violation |
35	|---|------|-----------|
36	| 8 | [app/globals.css:1657-1667](app/globals.css#L1657-L1667) | `.onboarding-step-active` = `oklch(62% 0.24 292)` = **purple**. Brand palette locked to Bone/Onyx/Stone/Rust. |
37	| 9 | [app/globals.css:1669](app/globals.css#L1669) | `.onboarding-step-done` = `oklch(58% 0.18 145)` = green. Not a brand color. |
38	| 10 | [(auth)/layout.tsx:68](app/(auth)/layout.tsx#L68) | Inline raw hex `style={{ color: '#B23A2B' }}`. Must use `var(--color-rust)` / `text-rust`. |
39	| 11 | [OnboardingWizard.tsx:69](components/onboarding/OnboardingWizard.tsx#L69) | `bg-success/60` on step connector. `success` is not a locked brand token. |
40	| 12 | [OnboardingWizard.tsx:110](components/onboarding/OnboardingWizard.tsx#L110) | Decorative 3px primary bar at top of card — unneeded and breaks the "solid surface" rule. |
41	
42	### Code quality
43	
44	| # | File | Issue |
45	|---|------|-------|
46	| 13 | [StepBookingPageLive.tsx:41](components/onboarding/StepBookingPageLive.tsx#L41) | `@ts-expect-error` for posthog — must type properly via `window.posthog` ambient decl. |
47	| 14 | [StepBookingPageLive.tsx:103-108](components/onboarding/StepBookingPageLive.tsx#L103-L108) | Non-standard `render=<a/>` on Button. Use `asChild` pattern. |
48	| 15 | [StepFirstLocation.tsx:143,174](components/onboarding/StepFirstLocation.tsx#L143), [StepFirstService.tsx:105](components/onboarding/StepFirstService.tsx#L105) | `grid grid-cols-2` with no `sm:` breakpoint — cramped on 375px. |
49	| 16 | No tests | `tests/` has no onboarding coverage. Zero Playwright or unit tests. |
50	| 17 | All steps | `localStorage`-only draft state — loses data across devices/browsers. No server-side resume. |
51	| 18 | All steps | No autofocus on first field. No explicit Enter-to-advance confirmation. |
52	| 19 | [OnboardingWizard.tsx](components/onboarding/OnboardingWizard.tsx) | No motion between steps — feels abrupt, not premium. |
53	| 20 | [(auth)/onboarding/page.tsx:29-37](app/(auth)/onboarding/page.tsx#L29-L37) | Resume logic only checks locations count. Doesn't detect WHICH step is next. User re-does completed work if they refresh mid-flow. |
54	
55	---
56	
57	## The New Flow — 4 Steps, Not 5
58	
59	Compressing from 5 to 4 by folding "First Artist" into Step 1 (the owner is already a `studio_member` at signup — we just need `full_name`, optional specialties, and one `artists` row). This kills the step with the highest drop-off risk ("why am I entering my name when I just signed up?").
60	
61	| Step | Title (serif) | Required fields | Deferred / skippable |
62	|------|---------------|-----------------|----------------------|
63	| **1. Studio** | *"Your studio."* | Studio name, timezone (auto-detected) | Logo, your specialties (chip picker) |
64	| **2. Location** | *"One location to start."* | Location name, city, country | Street, state, zip, phone |
65	| **3. First service** | *"Your first service."* | Pick a template OR fill custom | Description |
66	| **4. Go live** | *"Live."* | (display only — no input) | — |
67	
68	**What moved out of onboarding (to post-onboarding checklist on the dashboard):**
69	- Logo upload (deferred fully — dismissible "Brand your studio" card on `/dashboard`, reuses existing dropzone component)
70	- Street address / state / zip / phone (prompted on first booking that needs them)
71	- Team invites (separate settings page)
72	- Google Calendar connect (settings integration)
73	- Payment method (prompted when they try to charge a deposit)
74	
75	**Why 4 not 3:** the location step is load-bearing for the booking URL (city shows up in booking page). Cutting it makes the go-live screen generic. Four is the minimum that produces a *real* booking page.
76	
77	**Why not 5:** the artist step was drive-by busywork (name already known from auth email, specialties are optional everywhere else in the app). Merging with Step 1 saves ~20 seconds and a drop-off point.
78	
79	---
80	
81	## Server Actions — All Writes Go Through Here
82	
83	New file: `app/actions/onboarding.ts` — single module, five exports.
84	
85	```ts
86	// Signatures only — full Zod + implementation in the file
87	'use server'
88	
89	export async function saveStudioStep(input: StudioStepInput): Promise<ActionResult<{ slug: string }>>
90	export async function saveLocationStep(input: LocationStepInput): Promise<ActionResult<{ locationId: string }>>
91	export async function saveServiceStep(input: ServiceStepInput): Promise<ActionResult<{ serviceId: string }>>
92	export async function completeOnboarding(studioId: string): Promise<ActionResult<{ bookingUrl: string }>>
93	export async function getOnboardingState(): Promise<OnboardingStateSnapshot>
94	```
95	
96	**What each action does (uniform pattern):**
97	
98	1. `await createClient()` in `lib/supabase/server.ts` → session-scoped client
99	2. Verify `user` + membership in target `studioId` (use existing `studio_members` check pattern)
100	3. Parse input through `lib/onboarding/schemas.ts` Zod schemas (shared with client-side `react-hook-form` resolver)
101	4. Write to DB:
102	   - **Step 1 (studio + owner-as-artist):** UPDATE `studios`, INSERT `artists` row for owner if none exists, UPDATE `profiles.full_name`
103	   - **Step 2 (location):** INSERT `locations` (all provided columns including `phone`, `country` required, default `is_primary=true`)
104	   - **Step 3 (service):** INSERT `services` with `deposit_cents = Math.round((depositPct / 100) * basePriceCents)`, `deposit_required = depositPct > 0`
105	5. Emit audit log via existing [lib/audit.ts](lib/audit.ts) → `logAuditAction('onboarding.studio_saved', ...)` etc.
106	6. Return `{ ok: true, data }` or `{ ok: false, error: string }`
107	
108	**No service-role bypass.** All writes go through the user's session-scoped Supabase client. RLS policies on `studios`/`locations`/`services`/`artists` already permit inserts by owners (verified via Dato's RLS patterns — confirm during build, add migration only if a policy is missing).
109	
110	**Why Server Actions not API routes:** Next 16 Server Actions give us form-native progressive enhancement + automatic CSRF + typed return without an extra route file. Stack A standard per [~/.claude/memory/stacks/saas-nextjs-supabase-railway.md](../../memory/stacks/saas-nextjs-supabase-railway.md).
111	
112	---
113	
114	## Server-Side Resume (no more lost drafts)
115	
116	Replace the localStorage step tracker with a server-truth check on page load.
117	
118	`app/(auth)/onboarding/page.tsx` becomes a hydration-ready server component that reads:
119	
120	```sql
121	-- Pseudocode of the single query the page runs
122	select
123	  s.id, s.name, s.slug, s.timezone, s.logo_url,
124	  (select count(*) from locations where studio_id = s.id) as location_count,
125	  (select count(*) from services  where studio_id = s.id) as service_count,
126	  (select count(*) from artists   where studio_id = s.id and user_id = $userId) as artist_count
127	from studios s
128	join studio_members m on m.studio_id = s.id
129	where m.user_id = $userId
130	order by m.joined_at asc
131	limit 1;
132	```
133	
134	From that snapshot, compute `resumeAt`:
135	
136	- If studio has default name OR no timezone set → step 1
137	- Else if `location_count = 0` → step 2
138	- Else if `service_count = 0` → step 3
139	- Else → step 4 (go live) — BUT if all three are done AND the user hit `/onboarding` anyway, redirect to `/dashboard`
140	
141	The wizard gets `{ studioId, userId, studio, resumeAt }` and hydrates to the right step. localStorage is kept only as a UX softening — if server says step 2 but user was on step 3 locally, trust the server.
142	
143	---
144	
145	## Redesigned Step Indicator (brand-safe)
146	
147	Kill the purple CSS classes entirely. New indicator in `components/onboarding/StepIndicator.tsx`:
148	
149	- **Active step:** Rust-filled circle (`bg-rust`), Bone number inside, soft Rust ring via `shadow-[0_0_0_4px_color-mix(in_oklch,var(--color-rust)_12%,transparent)]`
150	- **Completed step:** Onyx-filled circle (`bg-onyx`), Bone check icon inside
151	- **Future step:** Bone background (`bg-bone`), Stone border + Stone number
152	- **Connector line:** `bg-onyx` for completed segments, `bg-border` (Stone-tinted) for upcoming
153	- **Label under each:** Inter 10px/600 uppercase tracked 0.08em, Stone for inactive, Onyx for active
154	- **Mobile:** labels hide (<sm), circles shrink to 6px dots inline with "Step X of 4" text on the right
155	- Respect **one-Rust-per-viewport** rule — active step is the only Rust in the right panel
156	
157	Remove the 3px top primary bar from [OnboardingWizard.tsx:110](components/onboarding/OnboardingWizard.tsx#L110). The card is the frame.
158	
159	Remove the [globals.css:1656-1667](app/globals.css#L1656-L1667) block. Done inline with Tailwind 4 utilities on the indicator element.
160	
161	---
162	
163	## Motion (restraint, not showbiz)
164	
165	Between steps: 180ms cross-fade + 4px upward slide on the new content. CSS-only via Tailwind 4 `animate-in` utility class + `data-[step]` attribute transitions. No Framer Motion — weight budget.
166	
167	- Step card container gets `key={currentStep}` so React unmounts/remounts, which triggers `animate-in fade-in-0 slide-in-from-bottom-1 duration-200 ease-out` on the inner step.
168	- The StepIndicator transitions its circle colors/ring via CSS `transition-all duration-200 ease-out`.
169	- No spinners on button click under 400ms. If the server action takes longer, swap label to "Saving…" with no spinner icon.
170	- Brand rule 4.5 honored: the only other motion on the page is the Onyx panel's hero (static anyway).
171	
172	---
173	
174	## Editorial Copy Rewrite (Quill voice)
175	
176	Per CLAUDE.md §6 — *editorial, quiet, confident. No exclamation marks. No hype.*
177	
178	| Step | Title (Instrument Serif 32-36px) | Subtitle (Inter 14px, Stone) |
179	|------|----------------------------------|------------------------------|
180	| 1 | *Your studio.* | "Two minutes to a live booking page." |
181	| 2 | *One location, to start.* | "You can add more later. The essentials are enough." |
182	| 3 | *Your first service.* | "Pick a template or write your own. You'll edit it later." |
183	| 4 | *Live.* | "Your booking page is public. Share the link." |
184	
185	**Field labels stay sentence case, Inter 11px/700 uppercase tracked 0.08em** per brand type scale.
186	
187	**Button copy:**
188	- Primary: `Continue` (no arrow glyph — too SaaS-y)
189	- Back: `Back`
190	- Skip: `Skip for now` (kept as ghost button, Stone text)
191	- Final: `Open the studio` (not "Go to dashboard" — editorial anchor)
192	
193	**Errors:** factual, no "Oops!".
194	- "Studio name must be at least 2 characters."
195	- "We couldn't save this step. Try again, or refresh the page."
196	
197	**Empty-state microcopy on the timezone combobox:** *"Couldn't find that timezone. Try 'New York' or 'London'."*
198	
199	---
200	
201	## Step 1 Detail — Studio
202	
203	**Fields:**
204	- **Studio name** (required, 2-60) — autofocus on page load
205	- **Booking URL preview** (computed, non-editable live preview) — `book.inkos.app/dark-matter-tattoo` updating as user types
206	- **Timezone** (required) — searchable combobox, defaults to `Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone`
207	- **Your name** (required, 2-80) — prefilled from auth session's `email` localpart if `profiles.full_name` is null
208	- **Your specialties** (optional, chip picker — 10 presets from existing list)
209	
210	**Logo:** NOT on Step 1. Deferred entirely. Shown on `/dashboard` as a dismissible "Brand your studio" card (first-visit state). Uses same file validation rules as today (2MB, PNG/JPG/SVG) — just relocated.

13	The entire InkOS palette is exactly four colors. Every pixel in every component below must use only these four, via CSS tokens — never raw hex, never inline styles with color values.

15	| Token (Tailwind utility) | CSS variable | Hex | Role |
16	|---|---|---|---|
17	| `bg-bone` / `text-bone` | `var(--color-bone)` | `#F7F7F5` | Page canvas, card surfaces, text-on-dark |
18	| `bg-onyx` / `text-onyx` | `var(--color-onyx)` | `#0F0F0F` | Primary text, primary CTAs, completed states |
19	| `bg-stone` / `text-stone` | `var(--color-stone)` | `#787774` | Secondary text, labels, borders, inactive states |
20	| `bg-rust` / `text-rust` | `var(--color-rust)` | `#B23A2B` | Active step (only), one accent per viewport |
21	
22	`bg-border` resolves to the Stone-tinted border token `oklch(91% 0.005 85)` — use it for connector lines and inactive borders.

53	### Layout
54	
55	```

57

129	### Connector line
130	
131	The connector is a `flex-1` `h-px` div between each pair of circles.

136	Rule: a segment is "completed" if its left-hand circle is in the completed state. The segment between completed step N and the active step N+1 is completed.

765	`CommandGroup` heading:
766	```
767	font-sans text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-stone px-3 py-1.5
768	```

770	
771	`CommandItem` (individual timezone row):
772	```
773	Idle:     font-sans text-[14px] font-normal text-onyx cursor-pointer px-3 py-2
774	          hover:bg-accent rounded-lg mx-1
775	Selected: same + Lucide CheckIcon (size-4 text-onyx) at far right
776	```
777	
778	`bg-accent` = `rgba(178, 58, 43, 0.08)` — the Rust 8% tint. This is the defined accent token and is correct for hover states (same as sidebar active row).
779	
780	### CommandEmpty
781	
782	The empty state message uses Instrument Serif italic on one line only — this is a "moment" as permitted by the brand (an empty-state editorial response). Classes: `font-serif italic text-[14px] text-stone py-6 text-center`.
783	
784	Text: *"Couldn't find that timezone. Try 'New York' or 'London'."*
785	
786	### Continent grouping
787	
788	Derived from `Intl.supportedValuesOf('timeZone')`. The prefix before the first `/` is the continent key. Groups and their order:
789	
790	```
791	Africa · America · Antarctica · Arctic · Asia · Atlantic · Australia · Europe · Indian · Pacific
792	```
793	
794	Omit `Etc/` and `UTC` variants — they produce noisy machine-legible strings. Only include entries that contain a `/` (which excludes bare `UTC`).

796	The `lib/onboarding/timezone.ts` module (Koda's file) exports this grouped list. `TimezoneCombobox` imports the grouped array — it does not call `Intl.supportedValuesOf` directly (that call belongs in the module).
797	
798	### Auto-detect on mount
799	
800	```typescript
801	// Inside the component (prose — not JSX):
802	// On mount: call Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone
803	// If the detected tz is in the grouped list, call onSelect(detectedTz) immediately
804	// If not found (rare edge case on unusual browsers), leave empty
805	```
806	
807	This fires once in a `useEffect([], [])` — no re-detection on re-renders.
808	
809	### Keyboard behavior
810	
811	All keyboard behavior is inherited from shadcn `<Command>`:
812	- `↑` / `↓`: moves through items
813	- `Enter`: selects the highlighted item and closes the popover
814	- `Esc`: closes the popover without changing selection, returns focus to the trigger
815	- Type characters: filters the list (Command's built-in fuzzy match)
816	
817	No custom keyboard override needed.
818	
819	### Data contract
820	
821	```
822	Props:
823	  value: string                   // selected IANA timezone string, or ""
824	  onValueChange: (tz: string) => void
825	
826	Emits: onValueChange(tz) when user selects a timezone
827	```
828	
829	### Accessibility
830	
831	- The trigger button: `aria-haspopup="listbox"`, `aria-expanded={open}`, `aria-label="Select timezone"`.
832	- The popover content: `role="listbox"`.
833	- Selected item: `aria-selected="true"`.
834	- CommandInput: `role="searchbox"`, `aria-label="Search timezones"`, `aria-controls` pointing to the listbox.
835	- The `CommandEmpty` text is rendered in the DOM when the list is empty — no additional aria needed.
836	- Focus ring: `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring` on the trigger.
837	
838	### Shadow token
839	
840	Popover uses `shadow-lift` = `0 8px 24px -4px oklch(13% 0.015 85 / 0.14), 0 4px 10px -2px oklch(13% 0.015 85 / 0.08)`. This is the correct token for floating elements (command palette, tooltips, dropdowns).

845	
846	All transitions in this spec use:
847	- Duration: `200ms` (or `150ms` for micro-interactions like card hover)
848	- Easing: `ease-out`
849	- No Framer Motion — zero additional JS weight

137	  input: unknown,
138	): Promise<ActionResult<{ slug: string }>> {
139	  const ip = await getClientIp()
140	  const { success: allowed } = await authedRatelimit.limit(ip)
141	  if (!allowed) {
142	    return { ok: false, error: 'Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.' }
143	  }
144	
145	  const ownership = await requireStudioOwnership(studioId)
146	  if (ownership.error) return ownership.error
147	
148	  const { userId, supabase } = ownership
149	
150	  const parsed = studioStepSchema.safeParse(input)
151	  if (!parsed.success) {
152	    return { ok: false, error: parsed.error.errors[0]?.message ?? 'Invalid input.' }
153	  }
154	  const data = parsed.data
155	
156	  // Load current studio to get the existing slug
157	  const { data: currentStudio, error: studioFetchError } = await supabase
158	    .from('studios')
159	    .select('id, slug')
160	    .eq('id', studioId)
161	    .single()
162	
163	  if (studioFetchError || !currentStudio) {
164	    logger.error({ studioId, err: studioFetchError }, 'saveStudioStep: studio fetch failed')
165	    return { ok: false, error: "We couldn't save this step. Try again, or refresh the page." }
166	  }
167	
168	  // Compute new slug from studio name
169	  const rawSlug = slugify(data.studioName)
170	  let finalSlug = currentStudio.slug
171	
172	  if (rawSlug && rawSlug !== currentStudio.slug) {
173	    finalSlug = await resolveUniqueStudioSlug(supabase, studioId, rawSlug)
174	  }
175	
176	  // Update studios
177	  const { error: studioUpdateError } = await supabase
178	    .from('studios')
179	    .update({ name: data.studioName, timezone: data.timezone, slug: finalSlug })
180	    .eq('id', studioId)
181	
182	  if (studioUpdateError) {
183	    logger.error({ studioId, err: studioUpdateError }, 'saveStudioStep: studio update failed')
184	    return { ok: false, error: "We couldn't save this step. Try again, or refresh the page." }
185	  }
186	
187	  // Update profile full_name
188	  const { error: profileUpdateError } = await supabase
189	    .from('profiles')
190	    .update({ full_name: data.fullName })
191	    .eq('id', userId)
192	
193	  if (profileUpdateError) {
194	    logger.error({ userId, err: profileUpdateError }, 'saveStudioStep: profile update failed')
195	    // Non-fatal — do not block the onboarding flow
196	  }
197	
198	  // Upsert artists row for the owner.
199	  // artists table has a unique index on (studio_id, slug) — not (studio_id, user_id).
200	  // profile_id links to profiles.id which equals the auth user.id.
201	  // We check by (studio_id, profile_id) then insert or update.
202	  const { data: existingArtist } = await supabase
203	    .from('artists')
204	    .select('id')
205	    .eq('studio_id', studioId)
206	    .eq('profile_id', userId)
207	    .maybeSingle()
208	
209	  if (existingArtist) {
210	    const { error: artistUpdateError } = await supabase
211	      .from('artists')
212	      .update({
213	        display_name: data.fullName,
214	        specialties: data.specialties ?? [],
215	      })
216	      .eq('id', existingArtist.id)
217	
218	    if (artistUpdateError) {
219	      logger.error({ studioId, userId, err: artistUpdateError }, 'saveStudioStep: artist update failed')
220	    }
221	  } else {
222	    // slug column exists via migration 20260422200000_artists_slug.sql but is not
223	    // yet in the hand-written types.ts — omit from typed insert, DB default handles it.
224	    const { error: artistInsertError } = await supabase
225	      .from('artists')
226	      .insert({
227	        studio_id: studioId,
228	        profile_id: userId,
229	        display_name: data.fullName,
230	        specialties: data.specialties ?? [],
231	      })
232	
233	    if (artistInsertError) {
234	      logger.error({ studioId, userId, err: artistInsertError }, 'saveStudioStep: artist insert failed')
235	    }
236	  }
237	
238	  await logAuditAction(userId, 'onboarding.studio_saved', { type: 'studio', id: studioId }, null, studioId)
239	
240	  return { ok: true, data: { slug: finalSlug } }
241	}
